# Vertical Slides Example

## Vertical: Overview

::: {.card}
Use `↓` / `↑` to move inside this stack, and `→` / `←` to move across top-level slides.
:::

## Vertical: Design Notes

::: {.cards-2 .tight}
::: {.card .compact}
**Why use vertical stacks**

- Keep one topic grouped under a single horizontal chapter.
- Drill into detail without flattening the whole narrative.
:::

::: {.card .compact}
**Good use cases**

- One summary slide + two detail slides.
- Progressive build of a concept.
- Alternate views of the same figure or data.
:::
:::

## Vertical: Concrete Pattern

```markdown
# Topic Cluster

## Detail A
Content for the first vertical child slide.

## Detail B
Content for the second vertical child slide.
```

::: {.meta}
This stack is rendered from heading structure with `slide-level: 1`, no raw HTML sections required.
:::
